system.description:
The shield-walls of Dul Khagul and its Jotunas allies, the Boldock Wall, and any drilled company that fights shoulder to shoulder.

  • Shield Wall: while you carry a shield, ranged attacks against you and an adjacent ally have Disadvantage.
    • 9th level: Shield Wall covers every ally adjacent to you.
  • Drilled: Advantage on etiquette checks with soldiers and dwarven clans, and you are trusted on sight by any company that fights in a shield-wall.
